## Design

### 2026-10-06 – I added most of the items to the bom, except for the pcb which hasn't been priced yet, this includes the esp32c6 that will be the brains of the clock , the led ring that will display the time, and the

**0.5h**

I added most of the items to the bom, except for the pcb which hasn't been priced yet, this includes the esp32c6 that will be the brains of the clock , the led ring that will display the time, and the power supply that will keep the clock alive

### 2026-10-08 – I routed the pcb, this is what will connect the esp32c6 to the led ring, I designed it to have the led ring be soldered to it via wires, and I added a 330ohm resistor on the data line to protect the r

**1h**

I routed the pcb, this is what will connect the esp32c6 to the led ring, I designed it to have the led ring be soldered to it via wires, and I added a 330ohm resistor on the data line to protect the ring from voltage spikes,, I also added a 1000uF capacitor connecting 5v to ground to protect against voltage drops.

### 2026-10-08 – I designed a case for the clock that will be mostly 3d printed except for the front plate which will sit in front of the leds, this part will be a piece of frosted acrylic to allow the light from the

**1h**

I designed a case for the clock that will be mostly 3d printed except for the front plate which will sit in front of the leds, this part will be a piece of frosted acrylic to allow the light from the leds to shine through, I also added numbers on the outside of the housing and I designed in a gap for diffusion purposes

### 2026-10-09 – I improved the pcb, added a voltage level increase for the data pin on the leds becuase they take 5v data while the esp32 c6 only outputs 3.3v data from its data pins, this goes into the pcb after the

**1h**

I improved the pcb, added a voltage level increase for the data pin on the leds becuase they take 5v data while the esp32 c6 only outputs 3.3v data from its data pins, this goes into the pcb after the resistor to keep the protection against voltage spikes

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/c6Ymgfs9WFtqIB0OnENQKLKARJrHJAeg/fab63be6a1c09ee89b71c3562d046a37cf4580e4d884234be2a163ad99d9b249.png)

### 2026-10-09 – I updated the pcb to include power draw monitoring, as well as adding in resistors and capacitors to ensure that everything functions as intended, including resistors on cc1 and 2 of the usbc port tha

**3h**

I updated the pcb to include power draw monitoring, as well as adding in resistors and capacitors to ensure that everything functions as intended, including resistors on cc1 and 2 of the usbc port that I also added to protect the esp32 from the high power draw of the leds which would have probable damaged it.
